svg.title: Grounded answers across real tool boundaries
svg.desc: A coordinator delegates to two specialists. Model generation, MCP data access and knowledge preparation remain distinct workloads.
svg.text: Grounded answers across real tool boundaries
A coordinator delegates to two specialists. Model generation, MCP data access and knowledge preparation remain distinct workloads.

g.title: INDEPENDENT TASK JOB: RAG task container
SANDBOX ACTOR / WORKERPOOL: Drift worker
g.text: Input drift is not accuracy loss

g.title: PRIVATE V100 WORKER: GPU model server

svg.text: Worker pools scaled 2 → 4 → 2 per role. SDKs stay inside jobs/services; the knowledge store is mounted state, not a separate Milvus server.
Specialist results return to the coordinator.
Its final answer returns through the controller/UI.
The shared generation path is drawn once; all roles use it. Tool facts are checked independently of task completion. One control VM and one GPU worker do not establish host-level HA.
